title: Northline Hotel
shortDescription: An editorial booking experience for an independent hotel.
fullDescription: A hospitality concept focused on clear room discovery and a direct enquiry path.
challenge: Present rooms, location, and the character of the property without burying practical details.
solution: A restrained visual system, direct room comparison, and a prominent booking enquiry.

title: Saffron Table
shortDescription: A menu-first digital home for a neighborhood restaurant.
fullDescription: A restaurant concept that puts the menu and reservations in easy reach.
challenge: Make hours, menu, and reservations obvious on mobile.
solution: Clear information hierarchy with menu categories and a direct reservation action.

title: Form & Found
shortDescription: A quiet storefront concept for curated home goods.
fullDescription: A shop concept with considered product discovery and a simple checkout journey.
challenge: Help customers browse without visual clutter.
solution: A product-led catalog with clear filters and product details.

title: Counterpoint POS
shortDescription: A focused operating surface for daily sales and inventory.
fullDescription: A point-of-sale concept for small business workflows.
challenge: Keep common actions fast while preserving clear records.
solution: Task-oriented layouts for transactions, stock, and reporting.

title: Atlas Desk
shortDescription: A practical dashboard concept for coordinating project work.
fullDescription: A web application concept for tracking work across a growing team.
challenge: Make project status and next actions visible.
solution: A modular workspace with concise status and activity views.
